anomalies.observed: In the USB-Serial block of the CM4 sheet, the two 27R series resistors cross the USB data pair: the net USB_SERIAL_D- runs through R38 (27R) to the net labelled USB_DP_12 (the FT231X USB D+ pin), and the net USB_SERIAL_D+ runs through R39 (27R) to the net labelled USB_DM_12 (the FT231X USB D- pin).
anomalies.expected: USB_SERIAL_D+ must reach the FT231X USBDP input and USB_SERIAL_D- must reach the FT231X USBDM input (i.e. R38 should carry USB_SERIAL_D+ to the D+ pin and R39 should carry USB_SERIAL_D- to the D- pin).

evidence.quote: USB_SERIAL_D- --[R38 27R]-- USB_DP_12  /  USB_SERIAL_D+ --[R39 27R]-- USB_DM_12 (CM4 sheet, USB Serial block, U21 FT231X)

anomalies.impact: The FT231X USB data pair is connected with reversed polarity, so the USB-serial bridge cannot enumerate or pass data over USB.

parsed.summary: The CM4 carrier largely matches the specification (CAN controllers U8/U9 with 16 MHz crystals, LTC4412 USB power path, WS2812B LED chain, e-stop buffers, CAN TVS parts), but the USB-Serial block appears to have the FT231X USB D+/D- pair crossed at the R38/R39 series resistors, which would break USB enumeration.
